title: An anion outer-regulated electrolyte allows rapid desolvation to enable high-voltage lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9093-9104
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03465E, Communication
Qiujie He, Zhiwen Deng, Sicheng Miao, Ye Jia, Jianan Peng, Pengfei Xia, Changhaoyue Xu, Qiang Tang, Xuemei Zhang, Tiening Tan, Gaolong Zhu, Kaipeng Wu, Yongjin Fang, Yun Zhang, Wenlong Cai
An anion outer-regulated electrolyte was designed through the use of peripheral solvent molecules to achieve improved desolvation kinetics for high-voltage lithium metal batteries.
